build_starlette_app: build a Starlette app with gzip middleware and optional CORS for sentence transformer inference
create_get_pipeline: create a cached pipeline factory that instantiates the correct pipeline class from the TASK environment variable
configure_allowed_tasks: configure the ALLOWED_TASKS dictionary to map task names to their corresponding Pipeline subclasses
setup_startup_event: setup an async startup event that configures uvicorn logging and initializes the inference pipeline
define_routes: define Starlette routes with a GET status endpoint and a POST pipeline inference endpoint
